title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: Through this project, Concern achieved significant improvements in the health and nutrition of refugees, displaced individuals, and host communities by enhancing existing health and nutritional structures in health posts in IDP camps and health facilties in host communities. The intervention also strengthened community-based health services and community-based epidemiological surveillance. . OVERALL COUNTRY PROG: Provide the emergency response to health and nutrition needs to refugees, displaced, returnees and host communities . SPECIFIC OUTCOME: This project is allocated a score of 1 under the Nutrition marker as the emergency response focuses on addressing thehealth and nutrition needs of refugees, returnees and host communities in the Sila province, Chad through malnutrition screening and IYCF counselling for women.
